caption_L1: Here a is a bar diagram labeled Enterprise-value-to-EBITDA (EV/EBITDA) of leading online car and property classifieds worldwide from 2020 to 2022. A categorical scale from Adevinta (Norway) to carsales.com (Australia) can be seen along the x-axis, marked Factor. A linear scale from 0 to 80 can be found along the y-axis, marked 2022*.
caption_L2L3: Two of the 12 leading online car and property classifieds worldwide showing the highest  EV/EBITDA (between 60 and 80) from 2020 to 2022, are in the USA and one in India. The remaining ones are in the UK, China, Australia and Norway, with the majority showing an EV/EBITDA of around 20 or below, except for Norway which has EV/EBITDA of around 50.
